versions.content: The generator shall create conversation macros to convert counter ticks (given as argument) into real time. The format of the macro is OS_TICKS2<Unit>_<Counter>(ticks) whereas <Unit> is one of NS (nanoseconds), US (microseconds), MS (milliseconds) or SEC (seconds) and <Counter> is the name of the counter; E.g. OS_TICKS2MS_MyCounter())
